description: NaGaBr₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Br¹⁻ atoms to form distorted NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent GaBr₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent GaBr₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.09 Å. Ga³⁺ is bonded to four Br¹⁻ atoms to form GaBr₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids and edges with two equivalent NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Ga-Br bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.36 Å. There are three inequivalent Br¹⁻ sites. In the first Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Na¹⁺ and one Ga³⁺ atom. In the second Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Na¹⁺ and one Ga³⁺ atom. In the third Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Ga³⁺ atom.
